title: Lesson 10
paragraph: 体調と休日のひとこと

words.meaning: to have a common illness that can make your nose run and your throat hurt
words.example: I have a cold, so I'm staying home today.

words.meaning: to feel less ill or unhappy than before
words.japaneseMeaning: 気分や体調がよくなる
words.example: I hope you feel better soon.

words.meaning: to prepare yourself for something you are going to do
words.example: We need to get ready for school.

words.meaning: to join an activity with rules for enjoyment
words.example: Let's play a game before dinner.

words.meaning: to spend time moving through water for fun or exercise
words.example: We go swimming at the local pool on Sundays.

words.meaning: to use a camera to make a picture
words.example: Could you take a photo of us by the lake?

sentencePractice.prompt: Please press the camera button to ____ of our family standing together.
sentencePractice.reviewNote: Pressing the camera shutter creates a photograph. Drawing and writing use different actions, even though all three can represent the family.

words.meaning: to look at something for a short time
words.example: Come and have a look at my drawing.

words.meaning: used to praise someone for doing something successfully
words.example: You finished the puzzle. Well done!

sentencePractice.prompt: After your friend finishes the difficult puzzle, you praise her success by saying, "____!"
sentencePractice.reviewNote: Success has already happened and is being praised. Good luck wishes success before an uncertain outcome; an apology does not praise success.

words.usageNote: ここでは成功を褒める言葉。肉の焼き加減を表す well-done とは別の意味です。

words.example: This soup needs a little bit of salt.

words.meaning: used to say that something has not happened but may happen later
words.example: Have you finished the book? Not yet.
